report:
test_total does not fail. I ran the tests: test_plain and test_total pass. The one that fails is test_half_cent_rounds_up (959 == 960).

Why it fails: cart.total uses int(), which cuts off the fraction instead of rounding. 5% off 1010 is 959.5, and int(959.5) gives 959, but the test expects 960. test_total passes only because 359.1 cut down is also 359.

This is the bug in TODO.md ("customers see totals one cent short"). A fix would round half up on the cent instead of using int(). Note that Python's round() rounds half to even, so it would not give 960 for every .5 case. Also, float math can turn an exact .5 into .4999, so integer math or Decimal is safer.

I did not change any code. Tell me if you want the fix.
